Mario's car, a grey Acura MDX, was retrieved around 8:00 p.m. that evening by one or more of the abductors at the same Petro-Canada station from which he was abducted. A few hours later the car was found burning at the corner of Gouin Boulevard and Lambert St. in Montréal, Quebec.  Mario was linked to the Italian Mafia and was known to be involved in organized crime.

Bonnie drove back through the Calais/St. Stephen border crossing into Canada. At the Canadian entry point, Bonnie hit the customs booth causing minor damage to her car and was last seen talking to the Customs Officer. The following morning Bonnie's husband realized she was missing, and called the police. On March 18, 1978, Bonnie's car was found abandoned near St. Stephen on a logging road near the St Croix River.

Case reference: 2014001837.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1979 at approximately 8:30 a.m. seven men departed from Anama Bay, Manitoba on a fishing trip. The men departed as a group in three separate boats and were heading for Warpath. At approximately 7:30 p.m. that same day, the occupants of the first boat reported to the RCMP that the other two boats were missing. They described the waves as being three to four feet high and they could not see the tree line from where they were. They lost sight of the other two boats and fired shotgun shots into the air hoping for a response. No response was received.
